patents.title: Methods, systems, articles of manufacture and apparatus for producing generic IP reputation through cross-protocol analysis
patents.snippet: Methods, apparatus, systems, and articles of manufacture for producing generic Internet Protocol (IP) reputation through cross-protocol analysis. An example apparatus includes a data collector to gather a first data set representing IP telemetry data for a first protocol and a second data set for a second protocol, and a scoring engine that combines the signals into a single, protocol-agnostic reputation score more robust to any one channel being poisoned.

patents.title: Methods and apparatus to analyze network traffic for malicious activity
patents.snippet: Methods, apparatus, systems, and articles of manufacture to analyze network traffic for malicious activity. An example apparatus includes a graph generator that, given one or more input IP addresses, builds a graph data structure of related network entities, then uses graph-based features to classify traffic as malicious or benign across protocol families rather than overfitting to any single campaign.
